pandas.read_html

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Extract matching HTML tables and return a list of DataFrames.

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO
import lxml
print(pd.read_html(StringIO("<table><tr><th>units</th></tr><tr><td>2</td></tr></table>"))[0])
